claim_limits: Native archive extraction only; RSC5 resources keep their stored LZX compression. Model, texture and tuning decoding, GLB conversion and rendering remain unverified.
Car IDs are vehicle directory names under resources/vehicle/ (vp_ player, vpd_ downloadable-content player, va_ ambient), not decoded retail names or a verified playable roster.

Archive names are 32-bit hashes. A name is resolved only when exactly one plausible string harvested from this disc hashes to it; other entries keep 0x<hash> names. A resolved name can still be a hash collision.
Configs and garage UI textures join a car only when its full code occurs in the file name; rims, tires, brakes, shared vehicle effects and vehicle tuning are shared with ownership unknown.
Selection is a declared namespace boundary; runtime dependency closure and load precedence are unknown.
Checks establish byte extraction and source preservation, not game execution or visual fidelity.
